Done — built out the AWS estimate in US East (N. Virginia) with 3 t3.medium on-demand Linux instances (730 hrs/month each, 100 GB gp3 EBS) plus S3 Standard storage at 500 GB/month.

The monthly total comes to **$126.60** (no upfront cost, $1,519.20 over 12 months). Here's the public share link: https://calculator.aws/#/estimate?id=f5579109ab8ab10449f2837da0bd41d1fd002037
